desc: From the game Zenless Zone Zero, Hoshimi Miyabi, a female fox thiren, is the youngest ever Void Hunter, chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6, has always stood on the side of justice. Born to the famed Hoshimi Family, Miyab’s journey began as a child wherein she chose a toy sword at the Erabitori ceremony. She was destined to follow in the footsteps of the Hoshimi family's proud lineage of warriors, after losing her mother to the Fall of the Old Capital, she has since wielded her blade, Tailless, to combat the ethereals and eradicate the hollows once and for all.
